news.title: Meta raises $15 billion through bond sale to fund AI infrastructure expansion
news.summary: Meta Platforms is raising $15 billion through a five-part bond offering to fund its expanding artificial intelligence infrastructure investments. The fundraising highlights the growing reliance of major technology companies on debt and equity markets to finance the global AI race.

news.title: Glittering Prospects: Why Gold is the ultimate sweet spot this Dhanteras
